correctness.rationale: T_c=T_-+T_+, with diagonal single-band contributions fixed and D_inf-D(c)=2tr(T_-T_+). The cross term equals positive frequency triangle integral and Fourier time sinc² integral. Expand (2c+h)^-2 uniformly for |h|≤W and apply triangle Fourier transform to derive J=W²/(8π²c²)(1-sinc²(LW)cos4πLc)+O(c^-3). If LW is integer, the triangle Fourier transform and its first derivative vanish, leaving J′=-W²/(4π²c³)+O(c^-4)<0 eventually. Otherwise J′=(LW²sinc²(LW)/(2πc²))sin(4πLc)+O(c^-3), J′′ sign near its simple phase zeros proves exactly one alternating extremum near each k/(4L), with none elsewhere sufficiently large. Independently checked distinct frequency/time integrals and phase asymptotics at several L,W. This concerns quadratic trace defect, not individual eigenvalue ordering.
